c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    o.order_id,
    o.order_amount,
    SUM(o.order_amount) OVER (
        PARTITION BY c.customer_id
        ORDER BY o.order_amount DESC
    ) AS running_total,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY c.customer_id
        ORDER BY o.order_amount DESC
    ) AS order_rank
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id, o.order_amount DESC;
